claims.claim: TurnCompletedEvent carries a single field `usage: Usage`, emitted when a turn completes (Rust: `pub struct TurnCompletedEvent { pub usage: Usage }`; TS: `export type TurnCompletedEvent = { type: "turn.completed"; usage: Usage }`).
TurnCompletedEvent (TypeScript SDK mirror) has shape `{ type: "turn.completed"; usage: Usage }`.

Usage struct (Rust, codex-exec) has exactly five i64 fields in this order: input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens. cache_write_input_tokens carries `#[serde(default)]` (absent in older payloads defaults to 0); the other four fields have no default and are required.

Usage type (TypeScript SDK mirror) has exactly the same five number fields, same order, same names: input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens.

The source snapshots define no arithmetic or containment relationship between cached_input_tokens / cache_write_input_tokens and input_tokens (e.g. no comment or code stating input_tokens includes, excludes, or is computed from either cache field). Each field's doc comment describes it independently: input_tokens = "number of input tokens used during the turn"; cached_input_tokens = "number of cached input tokens used during the turn"; cache_write_input_tokens = "number of input tokens written to the prompt cache during the turn". No total/derivation formula appears in either file.

The source snapshots define no relationship between reasoning_output_tokens and output_tokens (e.g. no statement that reasoning_output_tokens is a subset of, or additional to, output_tokens). Each is documented independently: output_tokens = "number of output tokens used during the turn"; reasoning_output_tokens = "number of reasoning output tokens used during the turn". No formula or containment note appears in either file.

Local file docs/35/codex-exec-source.txt is byte-identical to the base64-decoded `content` field of docs/35/codex-exec-source-envelope.json (re-encoding the local .txt to base64 reproduces the same base64 stream as the envelope, modulo line-wrap width).
